name: 8032-sonnet-mixtral8x7bgptq8bit-1gpu
model: TheBloke/Mixtral-8x7B-v0.1-GPTQ at revision `gptq-8bit-128g-actorder_True`. The revision is part of the model and is not optional -- `main` is a different build of the same repository.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), 20 streams held in flight, bounded at 400 requests / 620 s safety, the first 40 completions warmup and the last 20 cooldown.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, exactly 512 prompt tokens (min = max = 512) and exactly 256 output tokens (min = max = 256), greedy (temperature 0.0), prompt sent as raw text (`request_format: plain`, no chat template).
purpose: A Mixtral 8x7B text-completion service extending 512-token documents by 256 tokens for 20 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# 2024-09-era AsyncEngineArgs: every key here is passed straight through, so an unknown
# key is a TypeError at engine construction. Do not add keys from a later vLLM.

# The revision is part of the model: `main` is a different build of this repository, and
# passing the model without the revision silently serves the wrong checkpoint.
model: TheBloke/Mixtral-8x7B-v0.1-GPTQ
revision: gptq-8bit-128g-actorder_True

# Pinned. The checkpoint's own config declares bfloat16.
dtype: float16

tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-model-len: 4096

# This engine's own defaults at this commit, written down so they cannot drift.
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
max-num-seqs: 256
block-size: 16
